def _make_policy(**overrides):
    defaults = {
        "excluded_repos": frozenset({"excluded_repo"}),
        "public_repos": frozenset({"public_repo"}),
        "private_repos": frozenset({"private_repo"}),
        "companion_authors": frozenset({"bot_companion"}),
        "window_start": datetime(2024, 1, 1),
        "public_cap": 2,
        "max_reviews_per_tick": 2,
    }
    defaults.update(overrides)
    return ModelShadowReviewPolicy(**defaults)


def _make_candidate(key, repo, title="feat: add feature", **overrides):
    defaults = {
        "key": key,
        "repo": repo,
        "title": title,
        "created_at": datetime(2024, 1, 2),
        "author": "user1",
        "author_is_bot": False,

    return ModelShadowReviewCandidate(**defaults)
